name: Global torch/comfy monkey patches (risk register)
plain: Not a method but a warning list. These packs replace functions on torch or comfy for the whole process, usually when a node runs or even at import, instead of using the patch API on one MODEL wire. If one breaks or never restores, every later job is affected. Listed from static grep; a pack needs to be installed and sometimes run for each to take effect.
math:
No formula. Targets seen:
comfy.samplers.sampling_function: AnimateDiff-Evolved (restores), FlareAI advanced-cfg (no restore in lines read), SipherAGI animatediff, TDNodes.
comfy.k_diffusion.sampling.sample_euler_ancestral: Animemory at import.
comfy.samplers.KSampler / calculate_sigmas / prepare_noise: efficiency-nodes, quadMoons (restores), ZML, Nukun.
comfy.samplers.CFGGuider.sample / outer_sample: H3Studio, LC123.
comfy.ldm.modules.attention.optimized_attention*: 10S STG (context manager), raylight, jn_comfyui, flow2 (also ModelPatcher.patch_model and load_lora_for_models).
F.scaled_dot_product_attention: sage-guard at import, several 3D and TTS packs swap with sageattn.
mm.PackedLayout.__init__: H3 suite, IAMCCS, H3 Motion Director, CineStack (H3 layout).
comfy.model_prefetch.prefetch_queue_pop: H3 AdaptiveCache.
comfy.model_base.MiniMaxH3: fxai-toolkit at import. comfy.model_base.WAN21.concat_cond: flow2. Krea2.extra_conds: Krea2Moodboard.
execution.*: many metadata, loop and cache packs (not sampling).
label: from code
surprise: Animemory replaces euler_ancestral on import, so merely having that pack changes that sampler for everyone (xpred wrapper; line 176).
